title: Acclimation Night Credit by First-Unit Performance — PAP Therapy Equipment
content:
# Acclimation Night Credit by First-Unit Performance — PAP Therapy Equipment

**Table.** The first weeks on therapy are credited on a PAP Therapy Equipment usage summary by how the unit first set up performed, taking its qualifying nights as a share of **30 nights** per window downloaded from it:

| Share of the first unit | Nights credited |
|---|---|
| under 50 percent | 5 |
| 50 percent or more but under 70 percent | 3 |
| 70 percent or more, or no window from that unit | 0 |

**The share.** The unit first set up is the unit delivered on the initial rental setup delivery in the device's service history, identified by that delivery's serial number. Its share is the nights of four hours or more in all the 30-night compliance windows downloaded from that serial, summed, multiplied by 100 and divided by 30 times the number of those windows. The share is compared unrounded.

## Both sides of each line (hypothetical windows)

| First-unit windows | Nights of four hours or more | Share | Nights credited |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 14 | 46.7 percent | 5 |
| 1 | 15 | 50 percent | 3 |
| 1 | 20 | 66.7 percent | 3 |
| 1 | 21 | 70 percent | 0 |
| 2 | 14 and 16 | 30 of 60, 50 percent | 3 |
| none | — | — | 0 |
